newsitem.title: CANADA: Eurogas in C$10.5 mln special warrant issue.
newsitem.headline: Eurogas in C$10.5 mln special warrant issue.

text.p: Eurogas Corp said on Wednesday that Canaccord Capital Corp and Eagle & Partners Inc agreed to acquire for resale five million special warrants of Eurogas at a price of C$2.10 per special warrant for gross proceeds of C$10.5 million.

Eurogas said each special warrant will be exercisable for one common share of Eurogas provided that if a receipt is not issued by the Ontario Securities Commission for a final prospectus of Eurogas which qualifies the issue of such common shares within 90 days of the date of issue of the special warrants, each special warrant will be exercisable for 1.1 common shares of Eurogas.
Canaccord with Eagle & Partners have the right to increase the offering by 10 percent percent or 500,000 special warrants for a period of 60 days after the date of issue of the special warrants.
The offering is slated to close January 29,1997.
Proceeds of the offering will allow Eurogas to proceed with drilling and to test the Alpha Prospect of the Sud Nefta Permit without any further syndication of the work program, Eurogas said.
